scientific_goal: Test whether the smoother exact remainder left by ten rank-one local spectral-excess projections is easier for the standard rank10 TCN63 neural SDE to learn than the earlier deeply notched contiguous-band remainder.
constraints: Identify the ten complex spatial directions and oscillator parameters from training repetitions 1-12 only; validation repetitions 13-14 are evaluation only and test repetitions 15-16 remain locked.
Preserve the spatial mean plus ten POD coordinates, native sampling, HP50 spatial-mean preprocessing, and the standard TCN63 constant-diagonal-diffusion architecture.
Define every target exactly as full minus the same ten filtered rank-one complex projections and verify reconstruction before training.
Keep the complex oscillator bank frozen. Evaluate both raw neural output and output projected through the fixed local-excess complement.
Judge learnability from long-rollout survival, remainder PSD shape and power, energy, increments and ACF; one-step NLL alone is insufficient.

arms.description: Matched five-epoch TCN63 one-step NLL test on the smoother local-excess remainder.
Short rollout-calibration follow-up only after the matched NLL parent is available.
